concept.title: Raising a safeguarding concern
concept.shortdesc: As someone worried that a child or adult is being harmed, I need to know how to report it, so that the right people act.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-023). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: members of the public, professionals.
Situation: Needs the right route, not a list of activities.
A good result: The statutory routes (children's and adults' social care front door, police, NSPCC) shown first.
How much it matters: Safety: a miss could leave someone at risk, so the bar is highest.
